messages:
maya: Quick ask — can someone run a short micro-sweep comparing A100 / H100 / L40S on baremetal? Need p50/p99 for seq=512 and 2048, across fp16/int8/4bit. Not full sweep, just an overnight noise-limited run.

jordan: I can kick it off tonight. Which model shape + batch mix?

maya: T5-XL-ish load (we use smaller weights for perf stability). Batch mix: 1/2/4 (roughly 60/30/10). Prioritize seq=2048 for the tail numbers.

sasha: @jordan please include NVLink vs PCIe toggle. Last H100 longctx runs showed NVLink improves p99. Also capture kernel-fallback counters.

run-bot: run-scheduler: scheduled job 2008123456-sweep on cluster-baremetal starting 02:00 UTC (nodes reserved: hw-03 hw-07 hw-11)

jordan: I'll use tools/perf/run-sku-sweep.sh with flags: --quant [fp16,int8,4bit] --mode [nvlink,pcie] --seq [512,2048] --batches "1,2,4". Will push perf.json and pprof.

devon: Reminder: drop caches between repeats and capture thermal state. L40S showed thermal throttling last month.

len: I'll tail temps and nvlink telemetry from the lab. Ping me when the job actually starts.

jordan: Plan: 3 passes (fp16,int8,4bit). Collect: perf.json, pprof (stacks+counters), nvidia-smi dmon, nvlink stats, driver logs. Any preferred pprof flags?

maya: pprof flags: --collect=counters --stack-sampling=1ms. Also annotate kernel names. Add nvidia-smi dmon at 1s.

sasha: Capture kernel fallback log: /var/log/redwood/kernel-fallback.log (tail -200) and runtime logs /var/log/redwood/runtime.log (tail -200). We want fallback counts per step.

jordan: FYI pushed PR #3456 with a micro timing fix in kv-cache path. If it lands before the sweep, mark runs as 'post-pr' vs baseline. @maya can you review?

maya: Reviewing now. If it lands mid-run, tag that artifact and freeze further runs until we triage.

run-bot: job started 2008123600; nodes allocated: hw-03(H100), hw-07(A100), hw-11(L40S). run-id: rb-2008123456-1

len: hw-11 temp jumped to 85C during pass 2 — throttling detected, I'm pausing the L40S worker.

jordan: Pausing L40S. Rerunning with fanprofile=high on hw-11 and adding extra cooldown between passes. I'll note in metadata.

devon: If fanprofile doesn't help, we'll move L40S tests to night2 and keep H100/A100 running tonight.

maya: After run finishes, upload artifacts to s3://redwood-bench/2008123456/ and paste link here. Also include a short post with p50/p99/token-cost per sku and a one-line note about any thermal or fallback anomalies.

sasha: 👍 I'll compute NVLink delta (nvlink vs pcie) and report kernel-fallback counts.

jordan: First-pass done for H100/A100. Artifacts uploaded: https://s3.redwood.local/bench/2008123456/artifacts.tar.gz (still uploading L40S after rerun).

maya: Nice. If numbers show any regression vs previous baseline (ref run 1991234567), open an incident and tag #eng-runtime.

len: Monitoring continues; will post final summary tomorrow morning UTC.
